projects.title: Premetric Structural Unification
projects.scope: On the paper’s licensed preparations, premetric constraints lead to Einstein-form response, the isolated free Schrödinger evolution with its full generator domain, and the calibrated Lorentz interval. The joined construction retains controlled curved scalar evolution, same-action sources and occupied operational networks.
projects.boundary: The continuum carriers, four-dimensional gravity branch, actions and parameters remain declared physical inputs. The smooth minimum-order Einstein classification uses the cited Lovelock input. Sourced Einstein balance requires combined-action stationarity; general interacting quantum theory, global coupled Einstein–Klein–Gordon existence and Standard Model completion are outside the construction.

projects.title: Lean Schrodinger Derivation
projects.author: Greg Partin (G. D. Partin)
projects.scope: Conditional exact relativistic-energy identities and a free correction bound, with a constant-potential single-plane-wave Schrodinger operator bridge in natural units.
projects.verification: CSI independently built the pinned first-party release and ran its verifier (2,142 jobs), inspected all 43 theorem axiom reports and checked concrete witnesses on 16 November 2026. Matching previously independently built dependency artifacts were reused; this was not a wholly cold dependency rebuild. Reports used only standard Lean axioms. The successful project CI and release have identical source trees.
projects.boundary: The free-Dirac mass shell is an input, not derived from lattice dynamics. The potential-bearing correction remains explicit: low momentum alone does not remove it for an arbitrary fixed potential. The analytic bridge is for a single plane wave with constant potential, not arbitrary wavefunctions, variable-potential PDEs, general dynamical convergence, the Born rule or experimental validation. External work; inclusion does not imply CSI affiliation or endorsement.

projects.title: Lean Klein–Gordon Derivation
projects.author: Greg Partin (G. D. Partin)
projects.scope: A selected linearized C19 lattice branch, its normalized long-wave spectral limit, and the Klein–Gordon differential equation for finite continuum mode sums.
projects.verification: CSI independently rebuilt the pinned project (2,226 jobs, using the pinned Mathlib cache), ran the unmodified release verifier, and audited 176 public theorem constants covering all 53 explicitly named public source theorems on 17 November 2026. Only standard Lean axioms occurred; a deliberately introduced custom axiom was correctly rejected. Project CI also passed at the exact release commit. This was not a wholly cold dependency rebuild.
projects.boundary: The action, background, polarization and rest-subtract/rescale/restore readout are declared model choices. The result is a normalized selected-branch limit, not convergence of arbitrary native lattice trajectories or a general native multimode solution with a common timestep. The continuum operator theorem covers finite mode sums, not completeness for general initial data. The massless continuum corollary is separate from the nonpropagating native zero-background case. No physical-particle identification or experimental validation is established. External work; inclusion does not imply CSI affiliation or endorsement.
